[color=#ffff00][head=3]Section 4: New-Life Rules[/head][/color]
[color=#a4885c]4.1[/color] Players maintain all in character memory up until going critical. ★
[color=#a4885c]4.2[/color] Characters who are revived retain only vague memories of the circumstances surrounding their death. They may remember broad details, but not specific events or individuals involved. For example, if you were shot, you may remember being shot but not who shot you. If you accidentally set yourself on fire with a welder, you may remember being burned but not how it occurred. ★
[color=#a4885c]4.3[/color] Players who respawn instead of being resurrected lose all memories of the current shift and may not return to the site of their previous death. ★
[color=#a4885c]4.3A[/color] Players who receive information about their death or previous circumstances from others may reclaim or repair any lost property, but should not use such information to regain memories or act on past events.
[color=#a4885c]4.3B[/color] Special exception for the ship-saving feature: players who encounter their former personal ship may recover it, [bold]provided ownership is transferred by a Command role or, if none are available, by an administrator[/bold].
